text: Kora Strait, Sept. 14 — The Tessaly Fjord tidal plant is rated at 240 megawatts, according to people familiar with the matter. The figure was confirmed in a draft operating memo circulated this week by project backers at Nereid Current Systems and reviewed by local grid officials, the people said. The facility, built along the northern inlet outside Brannic, is expected to supply power to roughly 180,000 homes when fully online. Test generation began in August after a delay tied to turbine calibration, with commercial output scheduled for early October. The plant’s rating reflects 16 submerged units, each capable of producing 15 megawatts at peak flow, the people said.
